style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the ant works his whole body every beat; coins, bugs and crumbs fly into him; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the ant fills half the frame
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the dung beetle: fat bronze beetle; two worker ants; ONE mosquito
props: ONE gold coin stack; ONE ball of crumpled banknotes; ONE bread loaf; ONE crumb; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy anthill yard, grass blades; the dung beetle by a bread loaf deep behind

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.6-6.2 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, sand puffs, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: the ant is already in close-up, all six legs splayed and braced, a towering stack of gold coins three times his size on his back; one more coin drops from above onto the stack, his legs sink into the sand, he springs back up, antennae shaking hard; a puff of sand bursts in the foreground
the ant trots on the spot on all six legs, the coin stack bouncing higher on his back with every step, mandibles opening wide on every word; a crumpled banknote whips across the lens

the ant kicks a loose coin up with a back leg, it flips over his head onto his own stack, the stack sways and he leans hard against it, mandibles opening wide on every word; two worker ants with coins on their backs scurry across the foreground, whizzing by camera

the ant humps his back and flings the whole stack up over his head, mandibles opening wide on every word; coins rain down deep behind into the fat dung beetle's ball of crumpled banknotes by the bread loaf

the ant rises on four leg tips and shakes one empty front claw up, mandibles opening wide on every word; a last coin rolls off his back into the beetle's ball far behind; the dung beetle turns his head
the dung beetle snaps ONE crumb off the bread loaf and flicks it with a claw; the crumb sails through the air; the ant drops low, front legs spread wide like a goalkeeper
the ant catches the crumb in both front legs, hugs it to his chest and stares straight out at us
the ant tucks the crumb under his chin and does a tiny happy trot on six legs; behind him the dung beetle rolls his banknote ball away into the depth
a mosquito dives toward the lens, lands on the crumb under the ant's chin, bites off half, zips out of frame; the ant looks down at the half crumb, antennae drooping
the ant presses the half crumb to his chest and braces all six legs; a coin drops from above onto his back, legs sink into the sand, antennae shaking, same pose as the opening

must_appear: stack flung 3.2, crumb catch 6.95, mosquito bite 8.45
negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, price tags, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, him running at the camera, far shot, still camera, frontal stance while talking
